home.title: Overview
home.intro: is a starter for offline-first mobile apps: Vue 3, Framework7 and Capacitor over a local SQLite database that screens read reactively.
home.openDemoSubtitle: Writes, the change bus, and pipelining
home.startBuilding: Start building by adding a module in src/modules/.

demo.title: Reactive
demo.intro: Nothing on this screen tells the list to refresh. Writes announce the table they touched, and the query watching that table refetches on its own.
demo.writesHint: A burst of writes collapses into one refetch, because the query debounces what the bus tells it.
demo.empty: No rows yet — write one and watch this list follow.
demo.busHint: Every event a write published. The list is subscribed to the same stream.
demo.pipeliningNative: {count} reads issued together, then the same {count} awaited one at a time. Reads stay outside the write lock and the native bridge pipelines them, so together should win by several times.
demo.pipeliningWeb: {count} reads issued together, then the same {count} awaited one at a time. In a browser this measures nothing useful — see the note under the result.
demo.ratioNative: Above 1x means concurrent reads are genuinely overlapping on the native bridge. Near 1x would mean something is serialising them.
demo.ratioWeb: Expected on {platform}: the web path is sql.js in memory with no bridge to pipeline, so issuing reads together buys nothing and adds a little overhead. The several-times gain is a device property — measure it there.

settings.title: Settings
settings.dialogText: Dialogs, sheets and toasts all come from Framework7 - no extra dependency.
settings.sheetText: A sheet modal. The Android back button closes this before it navigates.
settings.aboutText: Built on {'@'}cavulsqa/mobile-db, reactive-db and reactive-vue. Replace this text with your own.

tabs.title: Tabbed shell
tabs.subtitle: Tabs as data
tabs.text: Each tab is its own view with its own history, lazily loaded. Add a section by adding one entry.

f7.title: Framework7
f7.subtitle: Native iOS and Material
f7.text: Both themes ship; Settings pins either one or follows the device.

sqlite.title: SQLite
sqlite.subtitle: Kysely, offline-first
sqlite.text: Writes take turns on the one native connection while reads run in parallel.

reactive.title: Reactive queries
reactive.subtitle: No manual invalidation
reactive.text: A write announces its tables and every query watching one refetches, debounced.

back.title: Android back button
back.subtitle: Closes the top layer first
back.text: Actions, dialog, sheet, popover, popup, panel - then history, then minimise.

keyboard.title: Keyboard handling
keyboard.subtitle: Field stays visible
keyboard.text: Scroll-into-view on every phase of the transition, tab bar out of the way.

metrics.title: Query metrics
metrics.subtitle: Built in
metrics.text: Durations, cache hits and refetches per table, in the right-hand panel.

dx.title: Zero-boilerplate DX
dx.subtitle: Auto-imports and resolvers
dx.text: Composition API, i18n, Framework7 components and icons resolve without import lines.
